title: Confessions board per-source keying on IID contradicts upstream addressing
description: Security-pass remnant from project-LICHEN-worker6-lzgc review. spec/12-apps.md:1680 (confessions board) keys rate limiting 'per-source (IID or OSCORE context)'. Under upstream-yggdrasil-addressing the primary /128 embeds no IID, so IID keying of flooded/remote posts is unimplementable — same class fixed in 04-network.md §6.3.3 and 12-apps.md §18.4.1. Re-key on the full IPv6 source address (preserved end-to-end, 04-network.md §6.3.2) or on the OSCORE context where posts are OSCORE-protected; state which applies when.
